notes.title: YAG live presentation/Q&A
notes.notes:
YAG (Yet Another Gameboard) is a 3D VTT. 
=> https://discord.gg/D3r2fYvv

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/3fa4879481e6309df5e719b75e32beac9e4d7a38.png[/img]

Originaly designed for RPG, it can be used for any game requiring maps, pawns, and dice.
With the possibility to download pictures from the net and to add square/hexa grids, it is very well suited for wargames

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/952c1eed9be69326f8f3f82c233b0fca04d1a739.png[/img]

It offers thousands of 3D animated pawns in many universes: prehistoric, antiquity, medieval fantastic, medieval asian, pirates, western, modern, post apocalyptic, cyberpunk, steampunk, science fiction, toon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/51f956ddf645dfb4780359c8af4cf9f1c2bc13ec.png[/img]

And can procedurally generate dungeons and voxel terrains in a few clicks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/335bbf33e68435a5699a21ae795b4177c4bcbb58.png[/img]

3D dynamic ligthing and 1rst/3rst person control (keyboard and gamepad) allow some incredible immersion

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/5267f894c7298b29da0b11c86e23687277aba6c4.png[/img]

You can add many effects/filters to give your scene a special ambiance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/b2842dd0cf5f48473068aa3c6488ed9330710f6a.png[/img]

During this event, YAG will be presented by its creator in a live stream on Discord.
https://discord.gg/D3r2fYvv

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/85ed6f8231602b46d21235beedb40c44eece9850.png[/img]

This will be a nice opportunity to discover YAG through friendly conversations, Q&A and demos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/a8ca629d3efb04440bb98220d5f71fb4f160f195.png[/img]

Hope to see you there :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34333397/4df428336c723a87c6faa2840d5b3660b293711d.png[/img]

All pictures here are screenshots of maps that will be demoed during this event and will be available on the Yag discord server.

notes.title: Yag v0.11.0.0 is on the beta branch
notes.notes:
Hello,

Yag v0.11.0.0 is now on the beta branch.

It brings two major features:
- voxels
- new fully 3D pawns displacement mechanism

Voxels mean terrains are now computed and can be sculpted and painted.

Presentation video:
https://youtu.be/685Ty94OfvI

Voxels are quite a riche and complex subject so there are 8 tutorials on this subject:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqbyFLE0xcNG0BTAW-FFDgMLM7-SssuFB

Pawns displacement tutorial:
https://youtu.be/ft_46dNHJ30

Lots of screenshots:
https://imgur.com/a/vVt3Zrb

Details:
https://trello.com/b/ME8M2OMt/yag-en

For those interested, the saves used for the presentation video are available in the file sharing section of the Yag discord.

Cedric

notes.title: v0.8.4.1 on beta branch
notes.notes:
v0.8.4.1 is out:
- Modules management (to distribute games/campaigns in a single zip file)
- We can now use local pictures (from the disk) as well as URLs
- Gamma correction for pictures
- LUA is now called automatically => character sheets are fully automated
- New content: a polar bear and an orc tribe

The general video presentation:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txKINZTUlmM]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txKINZTUlmM[/url]

Modules are such a huge topic that they got their tutorial video:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=or7Brhm8vyA]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=or7Brhm8vyA[/url]

As this new important version has not been tested by a lot of people yet, i put it on the beta branch.
Just in case you don't know what's a beta branch on Steam, a quick tuto here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KetGu-4Y-l0]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KetGu-4Y-l0[/url]

I will put it on the main branch when enough feedbacks will be ok enough.
So feebacks are welcomed here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/736420/discussions/0/1841314700711904298/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/736420/discussions/0/1841314700711904298/[/url]
